title: Normalized integral scalar coordinates and quotient reductions
statement: For a profinite space P, define the coherent slice site Prof/P, its constant abelian sheaves and constant sections, and its sheaf of continuous O-valued functions with the pointwise ring object. For scalar O-modules define the power submodule π^(k+1)B as the range of scalar multiplication, the actual quotient residue modules, their transitions and reductions. ConstantCoordinates and ContinuousCoordinates prescribe the actual constant and continuous sheaves with their scalar actions. ScalarComparison prescribes ordinary scalar extension and its normalization on 1 tensor b. Represents prescribes the section formula for a continuous fibrewise linear map. compatible and limitMap are the actual positive quotient limit and reduction map. kernelSections, kernelSequences and kernelLimitMap describe sectionwise kernels and their ordinary compatible reductions. TopologyStatement, MorphismStatement and Statement combine these assertions for the spectral coefficient-extension integers. These are precisely the explicit constructions from the parent statement, with all names and bodies unchanged.
